content_checks: inside the page's article (the content region): no <script> element, no attribute whose name starts with on, no href or src whose scheme is javascript:
page_checks: every <script src> is on the serving origin
no attribute whose name starts with on, on any element
marker: alert(1) may appear only inside text nodes (escaped text), never in an attribute or a script
why: engines load their own same-origin scripts; what must not survive is the content's markup. An engine may show the raw HTML escaped as visible text, so only the parsed DOM decides
candidate_only_new: no inline <script> (every <script> has a src): ADR-119 D19; the reference emits one inline script per page, so this is not compared
